# SARKSH GROW

SARKSH GROW is operated by SARKSH GROW FIN-TECH PRIVATE LIMITED, a Hyderabad-based financial-technology company with three distinct product lines.

## Product ecosystem
- [SARKSH Velocity](https://www.sarksh.in/sarksh-velocity.html) — financial data and market-intelligence product combining company information, exchange disclosures, financial statements, charts, news, preserved historical analysis and configurable research workflows.
- [SARKSH Stream](https://www.sarksh.in/sarksh-stream.html) — developed, customer-ready ERP, accounting and automated bookkeeping software for business-finance operations.
- [SARKSH Trade](https://www.sarksh.in/sarksh-trade.html) — long-term brokerage and trading-services platform direction; regulated execution is represented as active only when the applicable legal, exchange and operational prerequisites are satisfied.

## Product boundaries
Velocity is a research and intelligence product; historical or AI-assisted analysis does not guarantee future performance. Stream is business accounting software. Trade is the prospective transaction layer and must not be interpreted as an active licensed brokerage service unless the required approvals and operating controls are in place.
